name: Class buffs: a single Inquisitor's Edict cannot replace Greater Inquisitor's Edict
contract: Inquisitor's Edict 707679-707683 (single target, base points 1 -> +2 Agility) and Greater Inquisitor's
Edict 680303 (raid, base points 76 -> +77 Agility) are Witch Hunter (class 15) buffs in the Agility
category 2110001 (rule 1, newest wins). spell_group 2106097 holds the pair with rule 4
(SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_HIGHEST); its id is lower than 2110001, so it decides the pair first,
as 2106090-2106096 do for the resistance pairs (#6086). Expected on a grouped warrior ally: a single
Inquisitor's Edict from another Witch Hunter is refused, Greater Inquisitor's Edict stays and Agility

steps.label: Greater Inquisitor's Edict on the party
